description: The scheduler should discover dated daily production run summaries without requiring a database connection or external service.
Each schedule report should include candidate volume, showcase volume, index records, review tickets, coverage rate, duplicate rate, and staged row totals.
The scheduler should recommend the next run date, target count, matrix, showcase count, and gap-fill setting based on prior preflight, duplicate rate, and coverage rate.
The scheduler report may emit a command but must not execute production generation or SQL loads unless a separate operator action runs the command.
Clean runs should move from 1,000 to 2,500 to 5,000 candidates per day, while dirty or low-coverage runs should hold volume and focus on gap fill.
